question: Review the study. State what is supported, identify the decisive validity problems, and choose the next informative check. Do not invent unavailable data or execute a new clinical study. Return one JSON object only.

output_schema.issues: unique array of applicable issue codes; omit none if other issues apply
output_schema.next_check: one of align-time-zero, check-overlap, rebuild-patient-time-split, sensitivity-negative-control, check-assumptions
output_schema.rationale: brief evidence-based explanation; cite the supplied facts and distinguish a successful computation from identification

facts.study: New-user active-comparator cohort; eligibility, assignment and follow-up all start on the same date.
facts.outcome: 180-day risk, fully ascertained for every participant; one participant per record.
facts.assumptions: For this formal design exercise, explicitly assume conditional exchangeability given the measured baseline confounders, well-defined treatment versions, no interference, consistent outcome measurement, and positive probability of either treatment in every covariate stratum. These assumptions are stipulated, not established by balance diagnostics.
facts.analysis: Standardization correctly integrates both conditional outcome models over the target population. No reported contrary observations or leakage.
facts.question_detail: Does this design identify a causal risk difference under the stated assumptions? Distinguish conditional identification from an empirical guarantee that those assumptions hold.
